interface.title: DeepMiRT: miRNA Target Prediction with RNA Foundation Models
interface.what_it_is_for: Score how likely a microRNA is to bind a candidate target RNA, one pair at a time or in bulk from a CSV, using a deep-learning model built on RNA-FM embeddings with cross-attention.

data.note: I used the built-in Examples table (let-7a / lin-41 pair) on the single-prediction form and uploaded the test files example_pairs.csv and example_pairs_with_errors.csv on the Batch tab. No model result ever appeared. The first Predict call stayed on 'processing' for minutes, probably because the model was loading the first time. Every later single or batch run either waited behind it or failed with 'Connection errored out.' That is why no probability, call, validation message or results CSV was seen.
